neighbours.label: a system or device action that happens on its own with no person acting, the verb that could take 'automatically'
fire: Renewals are then automatically billed to your card every year.
Your account won't be debited until the trial month has ended.
The app can be configured to launch automatically at login.
The garden lights will only turn on when night falls.
New maps are installed through the game's auto patcher.
The thermostat can be set to shut off after midnight.
Fees are deducted from the balance without any action on your part.
The backup runs by itself and the sprinkler will activate when sensors detect smoke.
quiet: He paid the renewal by cheque at the post office last year.
Your uncle called the bank and asked about the trial.
She opened the app and typed in her new password.
The gardener turned on the lights and walked down the path.
The players drew new maps by hand on large sheets of paper.
The janitor shut the windows and went home after midnight.
Fees were collected in a box by a volunteer at the door.
A neighbour saw the smoke and ran over with a bucket.

notes: The output direction's - side promotes ' automatically', ' automatic', ' automated'. Probes: 0.19-0.61 for system actions, including ones with no 'auto' word ('won't be charged', 'switch off after an hour'); the same verbs done by a person about 0.01.
